sober: OptiCompanion is on. I measure while you're away and only speak at pauses. Right-click me for settings.
friendly: Hi! I'm {mascot}. I'll run tiny experiments while you take breaks and tell you what I find. Right-click me if I get annoying.

action.shadow.csm_resolution: Halve the cascaded shadow map resolution
action.shadow.vsm_directional_bias: Lower virtual shadow map resolution for the sun
action.shadow.vsm_local_bias: Lower virtual shadow map resolution for local lights
action.lighting.lumen_probe_downsample: Place Lumen screen probes further apart
action.lighting.lumen_octahedron: Trace fewer rays per Lumen probe
action.reflections.lumen_downsample: Trace Lumen reflections at half resolution
action.reflections.lumen_max_roughness: Trace Lumen reflections only on glossier surfaces
action.effects.translucency_volume: Turn off the translucency lighting volume
action.post.screen_percentage: Render at 85% and let the upscaler fill in
action.geometry.lod_distance: Switch mesh LODs a bit earlier
action.cpu.skeletal_lod_bias: Use one lower LOD on skeletal meshes
action.shadow.vsm_rays_directional: Fewer soft-shadow rays for the sun (virtual shadow maps)
action.shadow.vsm_samples_directional: Fewer samples per sun shadow ray
action.shadow.vsm_rays_local: Fewer soft-shadow rays for local lights
action.lighting.lumen_short_range_ao: Turn off Lumen short-range ambient occlusion
action.lighting.lumen_mesh_sdf: Let Lumen trace the global distance field only
action.lighting.lumen_screen_traces: Skip Lumen screen traces for GI
action.lighting.distance_field_ao: Turn off distance field ambient occlusion
action.reflections.lumen_screen_traces: Skip Lumen screen traces for reflections
action.reflections.ssr_roughness: Screen space reflections only on glossier surfaces
action.post.dof_rings: Fewer depth of field sample rings
action.post.tsr_rejection: Cheaper TSR anti-aliasing of rejected pixels
action.atmosphere.fog_depth_slices: Fewer depth slices in volumetric fog
action.atmosphere.fog_history_samples: Fewer volumetric fog samples when history is missing
action.scene.far_shadow_off: No far-cascade shadows for these objects
action.scene.small_lights_no_shadow: Small local lights stop casting shadows
action.scene.light_draw_distance: Fade out local lights beyond 60 m
action.scene.lights_volumetric_shadow: Lights stop casting volumetric fog shadows
action.scene.dense_meshes_lod1: Show heavy meshes with their LOD1
ui.tested.empty: Nothing tested yet. Every experiment shows up here, including the ones that were not worth telling you about.
